verdict.rationale: The evidence describes automatic summaries, action items, decisions and topic-based minutes for every meeting. Nothing documents custom note templates or saved prompts tied to meeting types such as discovery calls, 1:1s or standups. The API's agenda-writing endpoints and the suggestion to 'pass transcripts to an LLM for tailored recaps' are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, not the product's own per-meeting-type templating, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format
